# Spider

> Web framework for Zig 0.17.0. `const spider = @import("spider");` Handlers are
> `fn (c: *spider.Ctx) !spider.Response`. Per-request memory is `c.arena`. Templates
> escape `{ expr }` by default. This file lists the public API with signatures; the
> source of truth is `src/spider.zig`. Agent guide: `AGENTS.md`.

## Minimal app

```zig
const std = @import("std");
const spider = @import("spider");

fn hello(c: *spider.Ctx) !spider.Response {
    const name = c.query("name") orelse "world";
    return c.json(.{ .hello = name }, .{});
}

fn item(c: *spider.Ctx) !spider.Response {
    const id = c.params.get("id") orelse return error.NotFound; // "/items/:id"
    return c.text(id, .{});
}

pub fn main(init: std.process.Init) !void {
    _ = init;
    var server = spider.app(.{});
    defer server.deinit();
    try server
        .use(spider.logger)
        .get("/", hello, .{})
        .get("/items/:id", item, .{ .roles = &.{"admin"} })
        .listen(.{ .port = 3000 });
}
```

## Build wiring (a consumer's build.zig)

```zig
const spider_dep = b.dependency("spider", .{ .target = target, .pg = true }); // .sqlite / .r2 / .qrcode / .xlsx likewise
const spider_mod = spider_dep.module("spider");
spider_mod.addImport("spider_config", b.createModule(.{
    .root_source_file = b.path("spider.config.zig"),
    .imports = &.{.{ .name = "spider", .module = spider_mod }}, // the config imports spider
}));
exe.root_module.addImport("spider", spider_mod);
```
Without `.pg = true` etc., `spider.pg` fails with "no module named 'spider_pg'". Without the `spider_config` import, `spider.config.zig` is ignored. `-Dio_backend=zio` selects the fiber backend (default `threaded`). First build fetches deps (network). `spider new` generates all of this.

## Server — `spider.app(decorations) / spider.appWithConfig(spider.Config)`

- Routes: `get|post|put|delete|patch|head(path, handler, comptime config)` → `*Server`, chainable. `config` keys (checked at compile time — unknown keys and `.public` with roles are errors): `.roles` (realm roles, any of), `.org_roles` (roles in the active org), `.public = true` (auth middlewares let it through), `.authenticated = true` (any logged-in user; 401 without an identity — `c.userId()`), `.policy = spider.policy("name", check)` (any other rule: `check` is `fn (*Ctx) bool` or `!bool`, runs after the role checks; false → 403, or 401 when no user; an error is the request's) or `.policy = spider.resourcePolicy("post_owner", Post, .{ .load = fn (*Ctx) ?Post|!?Post|!Post, .check = fn (*Ctx, *const Post) bool|!bool, .deny = .forbidden|.not_found })` (anonymous on a non-public route → 401 before loading; missing → 404; check false → 403, or 404 with `.not_found`; the allowed resource reaches the handler, loaded once, as a `spider.Loaded(Post)` parameter (`.value: *Post`) or `c.loaded(Post) ?*Post`; `Loaded` without such a policy → `error.ResourceNotLoaded`, 500; not visible to `*Sse` handlers). Rules about one model in one place (Laravel Policy / Pundit): `pub const Tickets = spider.policySet(Ticket, .{ .name = "ticket", .load = loadTicket, .deny = .forbidden|.not_found (default for all), .rules = .{ .view = canView, .update = isOwner, .delete = .{ .check = isAdmin, .deny = .forbidden } } })`; routes use `.policy = Tickets.route(.update)` (a resourcePolicy named `ticket.update`); handlers ask `try Tickets.can(c, .update, ticket)` (the rule as is, no loading); `Tickets.find(c)` is the loader; an action not in `.rules` doesn't compile, `.quiet_log = true` (success not logged), `.allow_http = true` (exempt from `spider.forceHttps`). Handlers read them with `c.route()`. The third argument is required (`.{}` for none). Every builder method returns `*Server`: chain them, or write `_ = server.use(mw);` as a statement. Paths: `/a/:id`, trailing `/*` wildcard.
- Handler forms: `fn(*Ctx) !Response`; with extractors `fn(id: spider.Path(i64, "id"), f: spider.Form(T), c: *Ctx)` (any order, bad input → 400); with decorations `fn(*Ctx, Dep)` where `Dep` is a field type of the struct passed to `spider.app(.{ ... })`.
- Middleware: `use(fn(*Ctx, NextFn) anyerror!Response)`, `useAt(path_prefix, mw)` (`"/admin/*"`).
- `onError(fn(*Ctx, anyerror) !Response)`; default mapping `spider.statusForError(err)` (NotFound 404, Forbidden 403, Unauthorized 401, bind/parse errors 400, pg constraint errors 409/422/503...).
- `mount(spider.Group)`, `group(...)`, `staticDir(dir)`, `staticAt(dir, prefix)`, `health(path, handler)`, `db(spider.Database)`.
- Features: `mountFeatures(@import("features"))` registers every `pub const` namespace of the module; `mountFeature(features.x)` one of them. Per feature: every `pub fn` with no params returning `spider.Group` in its `routes` namespace is mounted; `pub const jobs = .{spider.every(ms, fn (*spider.Hub) void)}` is scheduled; `pub fn boot(b: spider.Boot) !void` (`b.allocator`, `b.io`) runs in `listen()` before the first connection. Optional: `mount()` stays for anything else.
- Route table: `SPIDER_ROUTES=1` makes `listen()` print method, path, access (`public` / `authenticated` / `org:..` / `roles:..` / `-`, plus ` policy:name`), flags and background jobs, then return (no boot hooks); `SPIDER_ROUTES=json` prints one JSON line `{auth, routes:[{method,path,access,public,authenticated,roles,org_roles,quiet_log,allow_http,policy}], jobs_ms, duplicates}`. `writeRoutes(w)` / `writeRoutesJson(w)` write them. `spider routes [--json|--check|--lock|--diff]`: the table; the JSON; exit 1 if the app has auth and a route shows `-`; write `routes.lock`; compare with it (exit 1 on changes, 2 without a lock). A method+path registered twice logs a warning.
- `requireRouteAccess()` (or `require_route_access = true` in spider.Config): `listen()` fails with `error.RouteAccessUndeclared`, logging each route that declares no `.public`/`.authenticated`/`.roles`/`.org_roles`/`.policy` (directly or via its group's `defaults()`). Off by default. Built-ins `/up` and `/_spider/health` are `.public`.
- `hasAuth()`: a `use`/`useAt` middleware authenticates (Spider's providers mark theirs; an app's own session middleware: `spider.markAuthMiddleware(mw)`).
- Streams: `sse(path, fn(*Sse) anyerror!void)` (no config: declares no access), `sseWith(path, fn(*Sse) anyerror!void, comptime config)`, `sseInterval(ms, fn(*Hub) void)`, `sseHeartbeat(?ms)`, `sseSweep(?ms)`, `ws(path, fn(*Ws) anyerror!void)`, `wsInterval(path, ms, fn(*Hub) void)`.
- `listen(.{ .port = ?u16, .host = ?[]const u8 }) !void` — blocks. `deinit()`.

## spider.Config (spider.config.zig: `pub const config = spider.Config{ ... }`)

`port: u16 = 3000`, `host = "127.0.0.1"`, `views_dir: ?[]const u8 = "./views"` (null → `"src"`), `layout: ?[]const u8 = "layout"`, `env: .development|.production|.testing`, `keepalive_timeout_ms: u32 = 120_000`, `header_timeout_ms = 30_000`, `body_timeout_ms = 60_000`, `stream_write_timeout_ms = 10_000` (0 = off), `dev_reload: ?bool = null` (browser reload under `spider dev`: null = on when SPIDER_DEV is set; Debug builds only), `require_route_access: bool = false`, `max_body_bytes: u64 = 10 MiB` (bigger Content-Length → 413 before reading, connection closed), `origin_check = .{ .enabled = true, .trusted_origins = &.{}, .exempt_paths = &.{} }` (cross-site POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE or WebSocket upgrade from a browser → 403 before routing: `Sec-Fetch-Site` same-origin/none pass, else Origin must match Host or be trusted; requests with neither header — webhooks, servers — pass; `exempt_paths` entries match exactly, `path/...`, or anything under an entry ending in `/`), `trusted_proxies: []const []const u8 = &.{}` (CIDRs/addresses whose X-Forwarded-For `clientIp()` believes). `static_dir: ?[]const u8 = "./public"` (null: no static files; `staticDir()`/`staticAt()` override), `static_max_file_bytes: usize = 10 MiB` (the largest static file served; a file is read whole into memory per request; a bigger one is not served and the log says so), `workers: ?usize = null` (accept threads of the threaded backend; null: one per CPU). `env` is not read by Spider today (it only enabled live reload, now disabled).

## spider.Group

`Group.init(prefix)`; `get|post|put|delete|patch|head(path, handler, comptime config)` — same config keys and handlers as the server (plain, extractors, or a `spider.Handler` value), except decorations; `sse(path, fn(*Sse))` (ignores defaults), `sseWith(path, fn(*Sse), comptime config)` (like get: defaults apply); `useAt(suffix, mw)`.
- `defaults(comptime config)` (call before the routes): access rules/flags every route inherits; a route with its own `.roles`/`.org_roles`/`.public`/`.authenticated`/`.policy` replaces them (`.quiet_log`/`.allow_http` override one by one).
- `use(mw)`: middleware for every route of the group, after its RBAC checks, applied at mount (route-bound, not a path prefix).
- Mount with `server.mount(g)`, or return it from a feature's `routes.build()` for `mountFeatures`.
- Templates: read from `views_dir` in a Debug build, embedded in a release build; `.templates = .embedded | .disk | .auto` on the spider dependency (build.zig) forces one. It follows the `.optimize` passed to the dependency.
- `spider dev [--port N]`: runs `zig build dev --watch` (needs `const dev = spider_build.devStep(b, spider_dep.artifact("spider-dev-notify"), exe, .{ .assets = &.{"public/css/app.css"}, .templates = "src" });` in the app's build.zig, plus `dev.step.dependOn(&css.step)` and `spider_build.watchSources(b, css, "src", &.{ ".css", ".html", ".js" })` for a Tailwind step; generated apps have all three), restarts the app after each successful build and the browser reloads by itself; when only the assets changed the app keeps running and the browser reloads. A failed build leaves the running app up.
- App conventions: `spider.testing.expectConventions()` (a test; walks up to build.zig.zon) and `spider check [--strict]` report, with file:line and fix: routes outside a feature's routes.zig, UI kit classes instead of ui-* in templates (when src/ui.css exists), icon classes from sets src/styles.css doesn't load, features missing from src/features/mod.zig, routes without declared access when main.zig installs an auth middleware (static: configs in same-file constants are resolved, others assumed declared — `spider routes --check` is exact); warnings: inline style=, pasted <svg>, features without routes_test.zig. Rules: `spider.conventions`.
- Test its routes with real requests: `fn run() !void` does what main() does to serve (builds the server, calls `listen(.{})`); in a test `const app = try spider.testing.start(run);` (one server per test binary, on a free port of 127.0.0.1, whatever port the app asks for), then `var res = try app.get("/posts"); defer res.deinit();` or `app.postForm(path, .{ .title = "x" })`, `app.postJson(path, json_text)`, `app.request(.{ .method = "POST", .target, .headers = &.{"Cookie: a=b"}, .body })`. `app.with(&.{"Cookie: session=..."})` is the same app sending those header lines with every request (a signed-in visitor). `res.status`, `res.body`, `res.header(name)`, `res.cookie(name)`; `res.expectStatus(200)`, `expectContains(text)`, `expectNotContains(text)`, `expectHeader(name, value)`, `expectRedirect(to)`. Redirects are not followed. Give the test a scratch database (`db.init(gpa, io, .{ .path = ".zig-cache/test.sqlite" })` then `core.db.migrations.migrate(gpa)`).
- Test its access contract: `try spider.testing.expectRoutes(routes.build(), &.{ .{ "GET", "/posts", "roles:editor" }, ... })` — method, full path, access as `spider routes` prints it; the exact set (any order), else `error.RoutesDiffer` with the actual table printed.

## Ctx — request

- `c.params.get(name) ?[]const u8` (path params; also `_auth_*` set by auth middleware), `query(name) ?[]const u8` (raw, not percent-decoded), `queryDecoded(name) ?[]const u8` (decoded once like a form field: `+` → space, `%2B` → "+"; use it for user-typed text, and don't decode it again), `header(name) ?[]const u8`, `cookie(name) ?[]const u8`, `getPath()`, `getMethod()`, `peerAddress() ?[]const u8` (the TCP peer — the proxy, behind one), `clientIp() ?[]const u8` (the client: X-Forwarded-For walked right to left past `Config.trusted_proxies`; the header is ignored when the peer isn't trusted), `requestId() []const u8`.
- Body: `getBody() ?[]const u8`, `bodyJson(comptime T) !T`, `parseForm(comptime T) !T` (urlencoded or multipart), `parseMultipart() !spider.MultipartData`.
- htmx: `isHtmx()`, `isBoosted()`, `requestKind()`, `wantsJson()`.
- Identity (any source — providers fill it from the token; an app with its own users/roles fills it from a middleware registered after the auth one, e.g. `useAt`): `setUser(.{ .id, .email, .name })`, `userId() ?[]const u8`, `addRole(role)`, `setRoles(list)`, `roles() ![]const []const u8`, `addOrgRole(.{ .org_id, .org_name, .role })`. `.authenticated`/`.roles`/`.org_roles`/policies read these whatever the source.
- Auth/RBAC: `hasRole(role)`, `hasOrgRole(role)`, `hasActiveOrgRole(role)`, `activeOrgId() ?[]const u8`, `setActiveOrg(id) !void`, `isOrgMember(id)`, `getOrgByRole(role) ?[]const u8`, `orgRoleIn(roles, ?org)`.
- Errors: `setErrorDetail(msg)` / `errorDetail()` (detail for onError / default error body).
- Hubs: `sseHub() *Hub`, `wsHub() *Hub`. `db() spider.DatabaseCtx` only has `exec(sql)`; use `spider.pg`/`spider.sqlite` for queries.

## Ctx — responses (all `!spider.Response`)

`json(value, opts)`, `text(str, opts)`, `html(str, opts)`, `redirect(url)` (302), `redirectWith(url, opts)` (303 unless `.status` is another 3xx; carries `.headers`/`.cookies`, e.g. `c.redirectWith("/posts", try c.withCookie("author", name, .{ .encode = true }))`), `download(bytes, .{ .filename, .content_type = spider.content_types.xlsx|.csv|.pdf|.binary, .disposition = .attachment|.@"inline", .status, .headers, .cookies })` (a file: the name may be user data and is made safe; bytes are not copied, use `c.arena`), `view(name, data, opts)` (e.g. `"home/index"` → `src/features/home/views/index.html`), `viewFragment(template, component, data, opts)`, `render(template_string, data, opts)`.
`opts: .{ .status = std.http.Status = .ok, .headers = []const [2][]const u8, .cookies = []const [2][]const u8 }`.
Cookies: read `cookie(name) ?[]const u8` (raw) or `cookieDecoded(name)` (percent-decoded); `withCookie(name, value, spider.CookieOptions-like .{ .http_only, .secure, .same_site, .path, .max_age, .domain, .encode }) !ResponseOptions` (`.encode = true` percent-encodes the value: use it for text a person typed), `setCookie(name, value, opts) ![]const u8` (Set-Cookie string), `deleteCookie(name, opts) ![]const u8` (empty value, Max-Age=0; pass the same path/domain). `;`, CR/LF or control characters in a value/attribute, or separators/space/`=` in a name → `error.InvalidCookie` (spaces/UTF-8 in values are fine). htmx response headers: `.headers = try c.htmx(.{ .trigger, .trigger_after_swap, .trigger_after_settle, .retarget, .reswap = .outerHTML|.innerHTML|.none|..., .reselect, .push_url, .replace_url, .redirect, .location, .refresh })`; event with data: `.trigger = try c.hxEvent("spider:toast", .{ .message = "Saved", .type = "success" })`. Static files (`./public`) get an ETag always and `Cache-Control: public, max-age=31536000, immutable` when the URL has `?v=` (else `no-cache`; If-None-Match → 304). Direct: `spider.Response{ .status, .body, .content_type, .headers, .cookies }`. In Zig, a JSON key named `error` is written `.{ .@"error" = "..." }`.

## Templates (`.html`)

`{ x }`, `{ a.b }`, `{ list[0].x }`, `{ x ?? "default" }` — HTML-escaped. `if (cond) { ... } else if (...) { ... } else { ... }` with `==`, `!=` (right side is a literal), `<`, `<=`, `>`, `>=`, `and`, `or`, `!x`, `items.len`. `for (items) |it| { ... }` (+ `loop.index`). Boolean attributes and conditional classes: `{ disabled if (locked) }`, `{ "ui-btn-active" if (tab == "home") }` print the word/string only when the condition holds (`disabled="{ x }"` prints "false" and stays disabled — `spider check` flags it as `bool-attr`). `extends "layout"` on line 1, then `{ slot }` / `{ slot_name }` in the layout. Components: PascalCase files, `<Card title="{ t.title }" size="sm">children</Card>`, `{ slot }` inside. Trusted markup from Zig: `spider.RawHtml{ .html = s }` (also `?RawHtml`, inside structs/slices). `<script>`/`<style>` bodies are not interpolated. Data: a struct literal; strings, ints, floats, bools, optionals, nested structs and slices of structs. Every view also has `current_user` (`.id`, `.email`, `.name`) when the request has a user: `if (current_user) { ... } else { ... }` (an object that is there is true); data the handler passes under that name wins. A view file starting with `-- doc` is rendered as Markdown (no template processing).

## Postgres — `spider.pg`

Needs `.pg = true` on the dependency. `init(allocator, io, .{ .host, .port, .database, .user, .password, .pool_size, .mapping = .fail|.warn })` (unset fields read `PG_HOST`, `PG_PORT`, `PG_DB`, `PG_USER`, `PG_PASSWORD`), `deinit()`.
- `query(comptime T, arena, sql, params_tuple) ![]T` (`T = void` for statements), `queryOne(T, arena, sql, params) !?T`, `queryExecute(T, arena, sql)` (no params; `void` allows several `;`-separated statements), `queryOneExecute(T, arena, sql) !?T`. Params are `$1..$n`, bound, never interpolated. Struct fields map to column names; `?T` for nullable columns.
- Transactions: `var tx = try pg.begin(); defer tx.rollback(); try tx.query(void, arena, sql, params); try tx.commit();` or `pg.transaction(...)`. `pg.exec("BEGIN")` is refused (`error.UseBeginForTransactions`).
- Errors: typed `pg.DbError` (`UniqueViolation`, `ForeignKeyViolation`, `NotNullViolation`, `CheckViolation`, ...), details via `pg.lastError() ?pg.ErrorInfo`.
- Deprecated: `exec`, `execRaw`, `queryWith`, `queryOneWith`, `queryRaw`, `queryRow`, `queryAs`, `queryOneAs`.

## SQLite — `spider.sqlite`

Needs `.sqlite = true` on the dependency. `init(allocator, io, .{ .path = ?[]const u8 (null → env SQLITE_PATH, else "db.sqlite"), .size = 5 })`, `deinit()`, `query(T, arena, sql, params)`, `queryOne`, `queryExecute`, `begin()` → transaction (`commit`/`rollback`; a second call does nothing, so `defer tx.rollback()` is safe). Params are `?`. Mapping a row to a struct follows `spider.pg`: a field with no column of its name is `error.ColumnMissing`, a NULL column is `error.UnexpectedNull`, unless the field is optional (null) or has a default (the default). `query(i64, ...)`: first column of the first row, 0 with no row, the statement's error when it fails.

## SSE / WebSocket

- `Sse`: `join(channel) !void`, `joinWithReplay(channel)`, `subscribe(channel)`, `subscribeWithReplay(channels)`, `joinUser(u64)`, `send(event, data_anytype) !void` (JSON), `setRetry(ms)`, `lastEventId() ?u64`, `param(key)`, `header(name)`, `cookie(name)`, `wait()` (block until the client disconnects).
- `Hub` (`c.sseHub()`): `emitTo(channel, event, data)` (JSON, recorded for replay), `emit(event, data)`, `notifyUser(u64, event, data)`, `broadcast(msg)`, `broadcastToChannel(channel, msg)`, `broadcastToChannelFmt(channel, fmt, args)`, `emitHtmlTo(channel, event, html)` (HTML as is, one `data:` line per line, recorded for replay — for htmx `sse-swap`; render it once, no per-user data), `count()`, `channelCount(channel)`. `Sse.sendHtml(event, html)` for one connection. Multi-line data is framed one `data:` per line everywhere.
- `Ws`: `next() !?Message`, `send(text)`, `join(channel)`, `joinUser(u64)`, `broadcast(text)`, `broadcastTo(channel, text)`, `param(key)`.

## Auth

- `spider.keycloak.KeycloakConfig.fromEnv()`: connection settings from KEYCLOAK_BASE_URL/REALM/CLIENT_ID/CLIENT_SECRET/REDIRECT_URI; set the rest on the result.
- `spider.keycloak.Keycloak.init(allocator, io, .{ .base_url, .realm, .client_id, .client_secret, .redirect_uri, .login_path, .after_callback_path, .auth_skip_paths, .refresh_path, .active_org_cookie, .audience })`; `.middleware()`, `.loginHandler()`, `.callbackHandler()`, `.refreshHandler()`, `.authorize(c, .{ .endpoint = .auth|.registrations, .payload, .idp_hint })`. Sets `_auth_sub`, `_auth_email`, `_auth_name`, realm/org roles as `c.params`.
- Token → roles, for any OIDC provider (JwksConfig, and the same fields on KeycloakConfig/ClerkConfig): `.roles_claim` (claim name or dotted path; list or string; default Keycloak `"realm_access.roles"`; e.g. `"roles"`, `"cognito:groups"`, `"https://app.example/roles"` (Auth0), `"resource_access.<client>.roles"`; null = none), `.org_claims = .phase_two | .clerk | .none` (Clerk: the active org `o.rol` / `org_role`, "org:" prefix dropped, also the active org), `.map_claims = fn (*Ctx, std.json.ObjectMap) !void` (runs after, to add roles/orgs from any claim).
- An app's own users (what `spider g auth` generates in src/features/auth/): `spider.password.hash(c, password) ![]const u8` (argon2id, a PHC string to store in one text column), `spider.password.verify(c, stored_hash, password) bool`, `spider.password.decoy` (verify against it when the account does not exist, so a missing account and a wrong password take the same time and get the same message); outside a request `hashWith(arena, io, password)` / `verifyWith(arena, io, stored, password)`. Session: `return c.redirectWith("/", try spider.session.start(c, .{ .id = "7", .email, .name, .roles = &.{"user"} }))` (a Set-Cookie with a signed HS256 token, HttpOnly/Secure/SameSite=Lax, 14 days), `try spider.session.end(c)` (clears it), `try spider.session.token(c, user)` (the token for an API: clients send `Authorization: Bearer <token>`), and in main.zig `server.use(spider.session.middleware())` before the routes: it sets the request's user (`c.userId()`, `_auth_email`, `_auth_name`, roles: what `.authenticated` / `.roles` check) and returns `error.Unauthorized` (401) on a route that is not `.public` when there is no valid session; for pages use `spider.errorHandler(.{ .unauthorized_redirect = "/auth/login" })`. Secret: `JWT_SECRET` (env or .env; `spider.session.options = .{ .secret, .cookie, .max_age, .secure }` before listen() to change); without one a Debug build uses a random one per run, a release build fails. No session table: no revocation before expiry.
- `spider.jwks.JwksAuth` (generic JWKS/RS256: `.jwks_url`, `.issuer`, `.audience`, `.cookie_name`, `.api_mode`, `.roles_claim`, `.org_claims`, `.map_claims`, ...), `spider.google` (sign-in: `login(c, config)` redirects to Google with a random `state` also kept in a cookie; `callback(c, config) !GoogleProfile` checks that state, trades the code and returns `.id/.email/.name/.picture`; errors `OAuthStateMismatch`/`OAuthCodeMissing` → 400, `OAuthCodeRejected` → 401, `OAuthProfileFailed` → 502; `GoogleConfig{ .client_id, .client_secret, .redirect_uri }`), `spider.clerk`, `spider.auth` (HS256 JWT).
- `spider.rbac.requireRoles(roles)`, `requireOrgRoles(roles)`, `requirePolicy(spider.policy(..))` middlewares (same as route `.roles` / `.org_roles` / `.policy`).

## Other modules

`spider.env`: `get(key) ?[]const u8`, `getOr(key, default)`, `getInt(T, key, default)`, `getBool(key, default)` (`.env`, `.env.<SPIDER_ENV>`, `.env.local` load on first use).
`spider.logger` / `spider.loggerWith(.{ .quiet_paths = &.{"/up"} })` request logging; `spider.logFn` (timestamped `std_options.logFn`); `spider.gzip`.
`spider.errorHandler(.{ .unauthorized_redirect, .json_key = "error", .always_json = false, .toast_event = "spider:toast", .forbidden_view, .template_not_found_is_404, .messages = .{ .forbidden, .not_found, .conflict, .unprocessable, .busy, .bad_request, .internal } })` → an `onError`: JSON `{<json_key>, request_id}` (callers that accept JSON; every caller with `.always_json`, for APIs), htmx (status kept, `HX-Reswap: none`, `HX-Trigger` toast `{message, type}`), page (`forbidden_view` or text); 5xx logged with rid/user/org.
`spider.forceHttps(.{ .default_base_url, .base_url_env = "BASE_URL", .proto_header = "X-Forwarded-Proto", .allow_http_paths = &.{"/exact", "/prefix*"} })` middleware; `spider.varyHtmx` (`Vary: HX-Request` on HTML).
`spider.r2.R2`: `initFromEnv(io)`, `put(c, key, body, content_type)`, `get(c, key)`, `delete`, `head`, `copyObject`.
`spider.mail` (client of mail providers' HTTP APIs, not a mail server): `Mailer.fromEnv() !Mailer` once at startup (`MAIL_TRANSPORT` = `brevo` | `resend` | `postmark` | `log` (default); `MAIL_FROM` "Name <addr>"; `BREVO_API_KEY` / `RESEND_API_KEY` / `POSTMARK_SERVER_TOKEN`; `MAIL_BASE_URL`), or `Mailer{ .backend = .{ .brevo = .{ .api_key } } | .{ .resend = .. } | .{ .postmark = .. } | .{ .log = .{} } | .{ .memory = &outbox } | .{ .custom = Transport{ .ptr, .sendFn } }, .from = ?Mailbox }`, or `Mailer.fromSettings(.{ .transport, .from, .api_key, .base_url })`. `mailer.send(c, mail) !Receipt`; outside a handler `mailer.sendWith(arena, io, mail)`. `Mail{ .from: ?Mailbox, .to/.cc/.bcc: []const Mailbox, .reply_to: ?Mailbox, .subject, .html: ?[]const u8, .text: ?[]const u8 }`, `Mailbox{ .name: ?[]const u8, .address }` (`Mailbox.parse("Name <addr>")`), `Receipt{ .message_id: ?[]const u8 }`. Errors: `MailMissingFrom`, `MailMissingRecipients`, `MailMissingBody`, `MailInvalidAddress`, `MailInvalidHeader` (CR/LF or control characters in a subject or name) before sending; `MailUnauthorized` (401/403), `MailRejected` (other 4xx), `MailDeliveryFailed` (network, 408/429, 5xx). No timeout, no retry, no attachments, no SMTP. Tests: `var outbox: spider.mail.Outbox = .init(allocator)` + `.memory = &outbox`, then `outbox.count()`, `outbox.sent()`, `outbox.last()`, `outbox.clear()`.
`spider.push` (Web Push/VAPID), `spider.qrcode`, `spider.xlsx` (write and read Excel .xlsx files; opt-in, `modules/xlsx/README.md`), `spider.http_client` (HTTP client: `get|post|put|patch|delete|head(io, allocator, url, opts)`, or a persistent `Client.init(io, allocator, .{ .base_url, .proxy_url })` that reuses connections; `opts.proxy_url` takes `http://` or `socks5(h)://`, with `user:pass@`; https only ever goes through a tunnel; redirects are not followed; `modules/pacman/README.md`), `spider.http_client_mtls`, `spider.health`, `spider.zmd` (Markdown to HTML: `spider.zmd.parse(arena, text, .{})`; headings, bold/italic, lists, links, images, inline code, fenced code, `> ` blockquotes; everything the author typed is escaped and `javascript:`/`data:` addresses are dropped, so the result can go in a `spider.RawHtml`).
Internal/unstable (don't build on): `spider.ast`, `spider.form_parser`, `spider.template_max_component_depth`. Disabled: `spider.livereload` (kept for a future `spider dev`; not registered).
